fnol_text: My name is Tomas Thorne and I live at 318 Foxglove Way, Greenville, SC 29611. You can reach me on (555) 424-1912 or tomas.thorne@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 10 October 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2025-00080. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Please just tell me this is covered.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Thorne on (555) 424-1912 to acknowledge the claim. Tomas confirmed the loss date as 10 October 2025.
Site visit to 318 Foxglove Way. Neighbour Esther Khan was present and confirmed the timeline.
Tomas sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
